messages:
maria_cs: Quick CS weekly for Cobalt Health — caching + batching snapshot.

maria_cs: Key numbers: hit rate 38% (+6ppt w/w), avg batch_size 2.7, cost per 1k tokens $6.10 (was $8.40). P95 latency 420ms (target 300ms). error rate 0.8% (up from 0.3%).

devon_eng: nice improvement on cost. do we know which routes gained cache hits?

maria_cs: mostly /summarize and /chat/short — prefix reuse increased after tweak. hit-rate by route: /summarize 52%, /chat/short 33%, /embed 12%.

aj_infra: seeing latency spikes correlate with cache-miss bursts. logs show KV fetch times ~150ms when cold.

sam_sre: can we reduce P95 by lowering batch window? what's current window?

devon_eng: currently window_ms=50, target batch_size ~3. if we try window_ms=20 should still hit avg batch 2.4 and reduce latency.

maria_cs: action: devon to test window_ms=20 in staging, aj to add KV prefetch for /summarize, sam to monitor error spikes. I'll schedule enablement session with Cobalt next Wed. :calendar:

devon_eng: will run A/B for window_ms=20 vs 50 today. config snippet I'll apply:
```
batching:
  window_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  target_batch_size: 3
```

aj_infra: enabling prefetch for high reuse prefixes — rollout flag `prefetch_v1` ON for cobalt-prod.

billing-bot: FYI — spend down 22% this week due to hit-rate + batching; projected monthly savings ~$4.6k.

maria_cs: thanks team. followups: 1) devon post A/B numbers, 2) aj confirm KV latency drops, 3) sam watch error rate — if >1% revert. I'll update Cobalt in 24h. :thumbsup:
